## Overview

- Install once per project: `quarto add benkirk/NCAR_beamer_template`
- Render with `format: ncar-beamer` (PDF) or `ncar-revealjs` (HTML)
- Every beamer feature of the LaTeX theme is reachable from Markdown

# Basics

A paragraph right after a divider becomes its subtitle.

## A Basic Slide

- Poppins Bold headlines, Poppins Regular body text
  - Dark Blue on white is the primary text color
    - accents (orange, yellow) only in small amounts
- Use [alerted text]{.alert} sparingly

1. Numbered items
2. Carry the brand color, too

$$
\frac{\partial u}{\partial t} + (u\cdot\nabla)u = -\frac{1}{\rho}\nabla p + \nu\nabla^2 u
$$

## Blocks

### Regular block

Level-3 headings inside a slide become beamer blocks.

### Example block {.example}

Add `{.example}` to the heading.

### Alert block {.alert}

Or `{.alert}` -- keep these rare.
